camel_example: aliyun dataworks-public ListLineageRelationships --region cn-hangzhou --Order Asc --SrcEntityId 'maxcompute-table:::project_name:_schema_name_:table_name' --SrcEntityName srcName --PageSize 10 --DstEntityName dstName --PageNumber 1 --SortBy Name --DstEntityId 'dlf-table::catalog_id:database_name::table_name'
description_en: Queries the list of data lineage relationships between two specified entities (tables, fields, OSS files, etc.) in DataWorks Data Map
description_zh: 查询数据地图给定两实体（表、字段、oss文件等）之间的血缘关系信息列表
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-lineage-relationships --src-entity-id maxcompute-table:::project_name:_schema_name_:table_name --dst-entity-id dlf-table::catalog_id:database_name::table_name --src-entity-name srcName --dst-entity-name dstName --sort-by Name --order Asc --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLineageRelationships

parameters.help_en:
The source entity ID. You can use the table or field ID returned by the ListTables or ListColumns operation, or use a custom entity ID.

To obtain the table or field entity ID, first call ListCrawlers to obtain the MetaEntityId of the metadata crawler. For types that contain data catalog levels, such as DLF and StarRocks, call ListCatalogs to obtain the catalog ID. Then call ListDatabases to obtain the database ID. If necessary, call ListSchemas to obtain the schema ID. Finally, call ListTables or ListColumns to obtain the table or field ID
parameters.help_zh:
源实体 ID，可参考 ListTables/ListColumns 接口返回的表/字段 ID，也可以使用自定义实体 ID。

获取表或字段实体 ID 时，请先调用 ListCrawlers 获取元数据采集器的 MetaEntityId；对于 DLF、StarRocks 等包含数据目录层级的类型，再调用 ListCatalogs 获取目录 ID；随后调用 ListDatabases 获取数据库 ID，必要时调用 ListSchemas 获取模式 ID，最后调用 ListTables 或 ListColumns 获取表或字段 ID
